requirements.title: Rules execute in deterministic order
requirements.description: Engine rules shall execute in deterministic ID-sorted order to produce reproducible reports.

requirements.title: Rule errors collected without abort
requirements.description: A rule execution error shall be recorded as a finding without aborting the remaining rule set.

requirements.title: HasErrors reports true on ERROR severity
requirements.description: The engine result shall report HasErrors true when any finding has ERROR severity.

requirements.title: Default engine contains all five built-in rules
requirements.description: make_default_engine() shall register exactly FUSA001 through FUSA005.

requirements.title: FUSA001 config presence check
requirements.description: FUSA001 shall fire when .fusa.json is absent and pass when it is present.

requirements.title: FUSA002 annotation presence check
requirements.description: FUSA002 shall fire when no //fusa:req annotation exists in source.

requirements.title: FUSA003 version field check
requirements.description: FUSA003 shall fire when the project version is empty or 0.0.0.

requirements.title: FUSA004 test evidence presence
requirements.description: FUSA004 shall fire when .fusa-evidence.json is absent from the project root.

requirements.title: FUSA005 changelog presence
requirements.description: FUSA005 shall fire when CHANGELOG.md is absent or empty.

requirements.title: Missing config returns error
requirements.description: Loading a .fusa.json that does not exist shall return an error, not a zero-value struct.

requirements.title: Malformed config JSON returns error
requirements.description: A .fusa.json with invalid JSON syntax shall return a parse error.

requirements.title: Default config has safe values
requirements.description: config::defaults() shall return a valid config with non-empty project and version fields.

requirements.title: Config round-trips through JSON save and load
requirements.description: A config saved to disk and reloaded shall equal the original.

requirements.title: Exclude patterns respected by analysis
requirements.description: Findings from paths matching an exclude_pattern shall be suppressed.

requirements.title: Source dirs configurable
requirements.description: source_dirs in .fusa.json shall restrict which directories are scanned.

requirements.title: No-subcommand prints usage
requirements.description: Invoking cpfusa with no subcommand shall print usage text and exit non-zero.

requirements.title: --version prints version string
requirements.description: cpfusa --version shall print the version string and exit zero.

requirements.title: check exits zero on no ERRORs
requirements.description: cpfusa check shall exit 0 when no ERROR-severity findings are present.

requirements.title: check exits one on any ERROR
requirements.description: cpfusa check shall exit 1 when at least one ERROR-severity finding is present.

requirements.title: --strict exits non-zero on WARNING
requirements.description: cpfusa check --strict shall exit non-zero when any WARNING finding is present.

requirements.title: qualify exits zero and writes report
requirements.description: cpfusa qualify shall exit 0 and write qualify-report.json when all cases pass.

requirements.title: lint subcommand available
requirements.description: cpfusa lint shall be a registered subcommand that runs LINT001-010 rules.

requirements.title: trace subcommand available
requirements.description: cpfusa trace shall be a registered subcommand that prints the traceability matrix.

requirements.title: cyber subcommand available
requirements.description: cpfusa cyber shall be a registered subcommand that runs CWE-mapped rules.

requirements.title: release subcommand creates SBOM
requirements.description: cpfusa release shall generate sbom.json, provenance.json, and artifact-manifest.json.

requirements.title: No raw new/delete
requirements.description: Smart pointers shall be used instead of raw new/delete.

requirements.title: No goto
requirements.description: goto statements are prohibited to maintain structured control flow.

requirements.title: reinterpret_cast justification
requirements.description: All reinterpret_cast uses shall have a fusa:unsafe justification annotation.

requirements.title: Safe-state before abort
requirements.description: abort()/exit() calls shall be preceded by a fusa:safe-state annotation.

requirements.title: Global mutable annotation
requirements.description: Global mutable variables shall carry a fusa:shared annotation or be made const.

requirements.title: No #define for constants
requirements.description: Numeric and string constants shall use constexpr, not #define.

requirements.title: No C-style casts
requirements.description: C-style casts are prohibited; named casts (static_cast etc.) shall be used.

requirements.title: Recursive function guard
requirements.description: Recursive function calls shall carry a fusa:recursive depth-bound annotation.

requirements.title: No printf/scanf family
requirements.description: Type-unsafe I/O (printf/scanf) shall be replaced with std::ostream or std::format.

requirements.title: Exception specification
requirements.description: Functions that throw shall have their exception behaviour documented or use noexcept.

requirements.title: Thread-safe global access
requirements.description: Writes to shared global state shall be protected by a synchronisation primitive.

requirements.title: No raw pointer arithmetic
requirements.description: Pointer arithmetic shall be replaced by indexed access, iterators, or std::span.

requirements.title: No unbounded loops
requirements.description: Potentially infinite loops shall have a visible exit condition or fusa:bounded annotation.

requirements.title: No large stack allocations
requirements.description: Stack allocations exceeding 4 KiB shall be moved to heap or static storage.

requirements.title: memcpy on trivial types only
requirements.description: memcpy/memset shall only be applied to types verified as trivially copyable.

requirements.title: Weak cryptographic hash detection
requirements.description: Use of MD5 or SHA-1 for security purposes shall be flagged (CWE-327).

requirements.title: Weak symmetric cipher detection
requirements.description: Use of DES, 3DES, or RC4 shall be flagged (CWE-327).

requirements.title: Insecure random detection
requirements.description: Use of rand()/srand() for security-relevant randomness shall be flagged (CWE-330).

requirements.title: Unsafe reinterpret_cast detection
requirements.description: reinterpret_cast without justification shall be flagged as CWE-242.

requirements.title: Command injection detection
requirements.description: Calls to system()/popen() with variable arguments shall be flagged (CWE-78).

requirements.title: Hardcoded credential detection
requirements.description: Hard-coded passwords and API keys shall be flagged (CWE-798).

requirements.title: Unbounded input detection
requirements.description: Calls to gets() or scanf() without width specifiers shall be flagged (CWE-120).

requirements.title: Unsafe string operation detection
requirements.description: strcpy/strcat/sprintf shall be flagged as unsafe string operations (CWE-120).

requirements.title: Format string vulnerability detection
requirements.description: printf(var) calls shall be flagged as format string vulnerabilities (CWE-134).

requirements.title: Null pointer dereference detection
requirements.description: Dereference of potentially null pointers shall be flagged (CWE-476).

requirements.title: Text report includes rule ID and location
requirements.description: Text report findings shall include rule ID, severity, file, and line number.

requirements.title: Text report shows PASS or FAIL
requirements.description: Text report shall include a PASS or FAIL result line based on ERROR count.

requirements.title: Summary counts match finding severities
requirements.description: Report summary error/warning/info counts shall accurately reflect the finding list.

requirements.title: JSON report is valid parseable JSON
requirements.description: JSON format output shall be parseable without error by a standard JSON parser.

requirements.title: SARIF report conforms to SARIF 2.1.0
requirements.description: SARIF format output shall include the required tool and results fields.

requirements.title: Requirements manifest presence check
requirements.description: FUSA002 shall fire when no .fusa-reqs.json is found and requirements are unannotated.

requirements.title: Requirement implementation traceability
requirements.description: The tool shall scan //fusa:req annotations and match them to registered requirements.

requirements.title: Requirement test traceability
requirements.description: The tool shall scan //fusa:test annotations and report which requirements have tests.

requirements.title: Multi-ID annotation support
requirements.description: A single //fusa:req or //fusa:test line may list multiple REQ-xxx IDs space-separated.

requirements.title: Coverage percentage calculation
requirements.description: Annotated and tested percentages shall be computed as (count/total)*100.

requirements.title: CI gate for req coverage
requirements.description: --req-coverage N shall exit non-zero when annotated percentage is below N.

requirements.title: Gap report lists unannotated requirements
requirements.description: --gaps flag shall list only requirements missing an implementation or test annotation.

requirements.title: Test evidence collection
requirements.description: The tool shall execute ctest and capture results into .fusa-evidence.json.

requirements.title: Evidence bundle JSON format
requirements.description: .fusa-evidence.json shall include generatedAt, cppVersion, results[], and summary.

requirements.title: Test failure detection
requirements.description: The evidence bundle shall record failed test names and set summary.failed accurately.

requirements.title: Evidence bundle round-trip
requirements.description: A bundle written to disk and read back shall have equal summary fields.

requirements.title: Test result status values
requirements.description: Each result in the evidence bundle shall have status of 'passed', 'failed', or 'skipped'.

requirements.title: Built-in positive and negative test cases
requirements.description: The tool shall provide built-in positive and negative test cases for all engine rules.

requirements.title: Qualification report structure
requirements.description: qualify-report.json shall include total, passed, failed, results[], and a SHA-256 hash.

requirements.title: Isolated test execution
requirements.description: Each qualification case shall run in its own isolated temporary directory.

requirements.title: Qualification report integrity hash
requirements.description: The SHA-256 hash in qualify-report.json shall be verifiable by re-computing it.

requirements.title: SBOM presence check
requirements.description: FUSA004/release check shall detect absence of sbom.json and report it.

requirements.title: Provenance presence check
requirements.description: The tool shall detect absence of provenance.json and report it.

requirements.title: SBOM includes project and dependencies
requirements.description: sbom.json shall include project name, cpp version, and detected CMake dependencies.

requirements.title: SBOM conforms to SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD
requirements.description: sbom.json shall include @context and @graph fields per SPDX 3.0.1.

requirements.title: Provenance records build environment
requirements.description: provenance.json shall include platform, VCS revision, and generated_at timestamp.

requirements.title: Artifact manifest SHA-256 checksums
requirements.description: artifact-manifest.json shall record SHA-256 checksums for all evidence files.

requirements.title: SBOM and provenance are valid JSON
requirements.description: sbom.json and provenance.json shall be parseable by a standard JSON parser.

requirements.title: write_all creates all three artifacts
requirements.description: release::write_all shall create sbom.json, provenance.json, and artifact-manifest.json.

requirements.title: Evidence bundle packaging
requirements.description: audit-pack.zip shall contain all evidence files from the project root.

requirements.title: Audit manifest SHA-256 and size
requirements.description: AUDIT-MANIFEST.json shall list each packed file with its SHA-256 digest and byte size.

requirements.title: Audit pack is a valid ZIP archive
requirements.description: audit-pack.zip shall be a valid ZIP file readable by standard tools.

requirements.title: Empty project produces empty manifest
requirements.description: Packing a project with no evidence files shall produce an empty but valid manifest.

requirements.title: TARA scenario generation
requirements.description: The tool shall generate threat scenarios with id, threat, asset, and risk_value fields.

requirements.title: TARA risk rating
requirements.description: Each scenario shall have a risk_level of low/medium/high/critical from feasibility*impact.

requirements.title: TARA JSON output
requirements.description: tara.json shall be valid JSON containing a 'scenarios' array.

requirements.title: TARA Markdown output
requirements.description: tara.md shall be a Markdown document with a heading and scenario table.

requirements.title: TARA treatment field
requirements.description: Each scenario shall specify a treatment action: accept, mitigate, transfer, or avoid.

requirements.title: FMEA from class declarations
requirements.description: The tool shall generate FMEA entries from C++ class declarations found in source.

requirements.title: FMEA RPN calculation
requirements.description: Each FMEA entry shall have rpn = severity * occurrence * detectability.

requirements.title: FMEA JSON output
requirements.description: fmea.json shall be valid JSON with an 'entries' array.

requirements.title: FMEA CSV output
requirements.description: fmea.csv shall have a header row and one data row per FMEA entry.

requirements.title: FMEA non-zero RPN
requirements.description: All generated FMEA entries shall have rpn > 0.

requirements.title: FMEA project field set
requirements.description: The FMEA report shall include the project name from configuration.

requirements.title: GSN safety case generation
requirements.description: The tool shall generate a GSN safety case with Goal, Strategy, Solution, and Context nodes.

requirements.title: Safety case output format
requirements.description: The safety case shall be written as safety-case.json, .mermaid, and .md.

requirements.title: Safety case evidence collection
requirements.description: generate() shall list evidence artifacts present in the project root.

requirements.title: Safety case nodes have non-empty ids
requirements.description: Every GSN node in the safety case shall have a non-empty id and type.

requirements.title: Safety case edges connect nodes
requirements.description: Every GSN edge shall reference existing from and to node ids.

requirements.title: SVG badge status from finding counts
requirements.description: Badge status shall be PASS (0 errors), WARN (warnings only), or FAIL (errors present).

requirements.title: Badge render produces valid SVG
requirements.description: render() shall produce a well-formed SVG containing the status label text.

requirements.title: Badge written to fusa-badge.svg
requirements.description: write_badge() shall write the SVG to dir/fusa-badge.svg.

requirements.title: Report comparison categorises findings
requirements.description: compare() shall categorise findings as introduced, resolved, or unchanged.

requirements.title: Report loading from JSON
requirements.description: load_findings() shall parse findings from a JSON report file produced by cpfusa check.

requirements.title: Diff text rendering
requirements.description: render_text() shall produce a human-readable summary of introduced and resolved findings.

requirements.title: Empty diff on identical reports
requirements.description: Comparing identical reports shall produce no introduced or resolved findings.

requirements.title: Key generation
requirements.description: keygen() shall write a 64-char hex HMAC key using cryptographic randomness.

requirements.title: Artifact signing
requirements.description: sign_file() shall create an HMAC-SHA256 signature file at <target>.sig.

requirements.title: Signature verification
requirements.description: verify_file() shall verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature in constant time (REQ-SIGN003).

requirements.title: Tamper detection
requirements.description: verify_file() shall return false when the target file has been modified after signing.

requirements.title: Wrong key fails verification
requirements.description: verify_file() shall return false when the key does not match the signing key.

requirements.title: Pre-commit hook installation
requirements.description: install() shall write a cpfusa check --strict pre-commit hook to .git/hooks/pre-commit.

requirements.title: Hook removal
requirements.description: remove() shall delete the pre-commit hook installed by cpfusa.

requirements.title: Hook script shebang
requirements.description: The pre-commit hook script shall start with a #!/bin/sh shebang line.

requirements.title: Watchdog timer
requirements.description: A RAII watchdog timer shall detect task hangs in safety-critical loops.

requirements.title: Safe-state scope guard
requirements.description: SafeStateGuard shall engage the safe-state handler on scope exit if not committed.

requirements.title: Heartbeat liveness monitor
requirements.description: Heartbeat shall detect missed beats and call on_missed with configurable timeout.

requirements.title: Watchdog kick resets timer
requirements.description: Calling Watchdog::kick() within the timeout period shall prevent the handler firing.

requirements.title: SafeStateGuard commit prevents handler
requirements.description: Calling SafeStateGuard::commit() shall prevent the safe-state handler from firing.

requirements.title: Dependency vulnerability scanning
requirements.description: The tool shall scan CMake FetchContent declarations for known CVEs.

requirements.title: Vulnerability JSON output
requirements.description: vuln.json shall list each dependency with its version and any matching advisories.

requirements.title: Clean dependency has no advisories
requirements.description: A dependency not in the advisory database shall have an empty advisories list.

requirements.title: Advisory includes CVE ID and severity
requirements.description: Each advisory entry shall include a CVE id and severity string.

requirements.title: Component boundary diagram generation
requirements.description: boundary() shall produce a Mermaid diagram of component dependencies.

requirements.title: DOT graph output
requirements.description: boundary() shall also produce a GraphViz DOT representation.

requirements.title: External dependency detection
requirements.description: The boundary analysis shall distinguish internal components from external dependencies.

requirements.title: No external runtime dependencies
requirements.description: The cpfusa binary shall have no runtime dependencies beyond the system C++ standard library.

requirements.title: All timestamps use UTC
requirements.description: All generatedAt timestamps shall be in ISO 8601 UTC format ending in 'Z'.

requirements.title: Recognised standard identifiers
requirements.description: The tool shall recognise standard identifiers: iso26262, iec61508, iso21434, do178c.

requirements.title: NULL literal (MISRA M4-10-2)
requirements.description: The NULL macro shall not be used; nullptr shall be used instead.

requirements.title: Missing override (AUTOSAR A10-3-2)
requirements.description: Virtual member functions shall be marked override or final in derived classes.

requirements.title: Switch without default (MISRA M6-4-6)
requirements.description: Every switch statement shall contain a final default clause.

requirements.title: Empty catch block (MISRA M15-3-4)
requirements.description: Catch blocks shall not be empty; exceptions shall be handled or logged.

requirements.title: Throw in destructor (MISRA M15-5-1)
requirements.description: A destructor shall not throw exceptions.

requirements.title: Function-like macro (AUTOSAR A16-0-1)
requirements.description: Function-like macros shall not be defined; inline functions shall be used instead.

requirements.title: setjmp/longjmp (AUTOSAR A15-1-2)
requirements.description: setjmp and longjmp shall not be used.

requirements.title: dynamic_cast (AUTOSAR A5-2-3)
requirements.description: dynamic_cast shall not be used; prefer virtual dispatch.

requirements.title: Union usage (AUTOSAR A9-5-1)
requirements.description: Unions shall not be used; use std::variant instead.

requirements.title: volatile without justification (AUTOSAR A2-11-1)
requirements.description: volatile shall only be used for hardware registers, annotated with fusa:volatile.

requirements.title: Variadic functions (AUTOSAR A8-4-1)
requirements.description: Variadic functions shall not be defined.

requirements.title: Unsafe string functions (AUTOSAR A27-0-1)
requirements.description: Unsafe C string functions (strcpy, gets, strcat, sprintf) shall not be used.

requirements.title: atoi/atof (AUTOSAR A27-0-2)
requirements.description: atoi, atof, atol shall not be used; use std::stoi or std::from_chars.

requirements.title: Missing braces (MISRA M6-3-1)
requirements.description: if/else/for/while compound-statements shall be enclosed in braces.

requirements.title: errno usage (AUTOSAR A19-3-1)
requirements.description: errno shall not be used for error detection.

requirements.title: C library headers (MISRA M17-0-5)
requirements.description: The C standard library *.h headers shall not be included; use C++ equivalents.

requirements.title: #undef (MISRA M16-0-3)
requirements.description: #undef shall not be used.

requirements.title: Inline assembler (AUTOSAR A7-4-1)
requirements.description: Inline assembler (asm, __asm__) shall not be used unless fusa:unsafe annotated.

requirements.title: Magic numbers (AUTOSAR A2-13-4)
requirements.description: Numeric literals other than 0 and 1 shall not be used outside of named constants.

requirements.title: Include guard (MISRA M16-2-1)
requirements.description: Header files shall contain an include guard or #pragma once.

requirements.title: Virtual destructor (AST check)
requirements.description: A class with virtual methods shall declare a virtual destructor.

requirements.title: Variable shadowing (AST check)
requirements.description: Local variables shall not shadow outer-scope identifiers.

requirements.title: Raw pointer return without nodiscard (AST check)
requirements.description: Functions returning raw pointers shall be annotated [[nodiscard]].

requirements.title: libclang integration
requirements.description: The tool shall optionally link libclang to provide AST-level analysis beyond regex checks.

requirements.title: AST stub mode
requirements.description: When libclang is unavailable, the ast subcommand shall return an INFO finding (AST000) and exit 0.

requirements.title: CAL parsing
requirements.description: parse_cal() shall accept CAL-1 through CAL-4 (with or without hyphen) and cal_str() shall return the canonical form.

requirements.title: CAL-scoped objective assessment
requirements.description: assess() shall evaluate all applicable objectives for the specified CAL level and return a Report with non-empty objectives.

requirements.title: Evidence file detection
requirements.description: assess() shall check for tara.json, vuln.json, .fusa-reqs.json, cyber-report.json, sbom.json, provenance.json, safety-case.json, and .fusa.json and adjust objective status accordingly.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 gap report JSON
requirements.description: write_json() shall emit a spec §3.1 envelope with schemaVersion 1.9, kind gap-report, standard iso21434, and §9.3-conformant summary keys satisfied/partial/gaps.

requirements.title: Objective status values
requirements.description: Each objective in the JSON report shall have status ∈ {satisfied, partial, gap}.

requirements.title: UNECE R155 threat assessment
requirements.description: assess_r155() shall evaluate all nine R155 threat categories (TC-1 through TC-9) and return a Report with non-empty threats.

requirements.title: R155 evidence detection
requirements.description: assess_r155() shall check for tara.json, vuln.json, cyber-report.json, sbom.json to determine coverage of automatable threat categories.

requirements.title: UNECE R156 SUMS assessment
requirements.description: assess_r156() shall evaluate all six R156 software update requirements (SU-1 through SU-6) and return a Report with regulation UNECE-R156.

requirements.title: UNECE gap report JSON
requirements.description: write_json() shall emit a spec §3.1 envelope with schemaVersion 1.9, kind gap-report, standard unece-r155 or unece-r156, and §9.3-conformant summary keys.

requirements.title: UNECE objective status values
requirements.description: Each objective in the UNECE JSON report shall have status ∈ {satisfied, partial, gap}.

requirements.title: CSV import with duplicate skipping
requirements.description: import_csv() shall parse id,title,description,standard_ref,severity rows and skip any IDs already present in the target vector.

requirements.title: CSV export with comma escaping
requirements.description: export_csv() shall write a header row followed by one row per requirement, replacing commas inside field values with semicolons.

requirements.title: Canonical requirements save
requirements.description: save_requirements() shall write {requirements:[...]} in the canonical §1.2.2 format, and load_requirements() shall read it back correctly.

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity analysis
requirements.description: The comp subcommand shall analyse C++ source files for cyclomatic complexity and flag functions exceeding the configured threshold.

requirements.title: Coupling evidence required for DO-178C
requirements.description: COUP003 shall fire when coupling-report.json is absent in a DO-178C project, requiring the user to run cpfusa coupling.

requirements.title: ASIL mismatch detection
requirements.description: HARA005 shall fire when the highest hazard ASIL in .fusa-hara.json exceeds the project ASIL in .fusa.json.

requirements.title: ASIL field on requirements
requirements.description: ISO26262002 shall fire when any requirement in .fusa-reqs.json lacks an asil field in an ISO 26262 project.

requirements.title: Tool qualification failures
requirements.description: ISO26262003 shall fire when qualify-report.json reports one or more test failures.

requirements.title: DOORS ReqIF XML import/export
requirements.description: import_doors() shall parse SPEC-OBJECT elements from ReqIF XML. export_doors() shall produce a minimal ReqIF XML.

requirements.title: Polarion work-item XML import/export
requirements.description: import_polarion() shall parse workItem elements from Polarion XML. export_polarion() shall produce minimal Polarion XML.

requirements.title: SPDX 2.2 and 2.3 SBOM formats
requirements.description: write_sbom() shall support SPDX-2.2 and SPDX-2.3 formats in addition to the native cpp-FuSa SBOM v1 format.

requirements.title: Function length limit
requirements.description: ANAL008: Function bodies exceeding 60 lines must be flagged (WARNING). Enforces single-responsibility and aids code review.

requirements.title: Maximum nesting depth
requirements.description: ANAL009: Nesting depth exceeding 5 levels within a function must be flagged (WARNING). Deep nesting increases cyclomatic complexity and reduces readability.

requirements.title: Maximum function parameter count
requirements.description: ANAL010: Functions with more than 7 parameters must be flagged (WARNING). Excessive parameters indicate poor interface design and increase coupling.

requirements.title: No narrowing integer casts
requirements.description: ANAL011: C-style casts to narrower integer types (uint8_t, int8_t, uint16_t, int16_t, unsigned char, short) must be flagged (WARNING). Silent truncation may produce incorrect safety-critical values.

requirements.title: Maximum return points per function
requirements.description: ANAL012: Functions with more than 3 return points must be flagged (INFO). Multiple returns obscure control flow and complicate test coverage.
